name: HOW TO TRAIN YOUR DRAGON
desc:
Explore the world of How To Train Your Dragon as you travel across the islands, take on quests, meet legendary characters, and train your dragon to become stronger through every battle and discovery.

🔥 Take on enemies across the world and earn experience to level up your dragon
🗺️ Explore vast regions, discover hidden locations, and complete story-driven quests
📜 Meet characters from the world of How To Train Your Dragon and uncover their stories
🐉 Train, bond, and grow alongside your dragon to unlock its full potential
🎨 Collect and unlock unique dragon skins to customize your companion

Are you ready to train your dragon?
